skills.name: claxedo-workspace
skills.description: Explain and set up Claxedo, the open-source workspace that runs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode with one shared configuration of plugins, skills, MCP servers, and credentials. Use when a user wants several coding agents in one place or wants to configure them once.

skills.name: claxedo-install
skills.description: Download and install Claxedo Desktop for macOS, Windows, or Linux, and start in local mode without an account. Use when a user asks how to get or run Claxedo.

skills.name: claxedo-deploy
skills.description: Deploy the Claxedo control plane to the user's own Cloudflare account and enroll machines, following the credential-safety rules in the agent entry map. Use when a user wants to self-host or share sessions with a team.

skills.name: claxedo-compare
skills.description: Compare Claxedo with other coding-agent workspaces on open source, self-hosting, multiplayer, and sandbox support using the sourced comparison pages. Use when a user is choosing between agent workspaces.
